key_decisions: AUDIO cfg = 3.0 on #118 CFGGuider. Chosen by the user's ear over a measured sweep, not by a target number. It also revived the negative prompt as a side effect, so quality and level moved together

Normalisation was proposed by the user, investigated, and ABANDONED on evidence: Lightricks' own reference has no gain stage, and AudioAdjustVolume is a fixed INT dB with no peak detection, so a gain sized for one render clips the next

NAG option (a) over (b): (a) needs one node and applies the same negative through CFG and attention both; (b) would need a ConditioningZeroOut on #115.negative because that input is required, so it costs a node to do less

Width/height are gone rather than injectable BECAUSE this graph never delivers the encoded pixels. That is the opposite of ltx_v2v_template.json, where #28's output IS the delivered clip - do not carry this decision across to that file
EDIT THE BENCH COPY IN PLACE - NEVER REGENERATE. build_foley.py is a historical record, not a thing to re-run
